partnership_announcements.description: The US Army’s Joint Innovation Outpost and Picogrid established a collaboration in which JIOP procured and rapidly fielded Picogrid’s Legion platform and ECNs to address data-integration gaps in Army contingency operations.

press_references.value: Picogrid Collaborates with 1st Cavalry Division to Advance Integrated Counter-Drone Defense for U.S. Army

partnership_announcements.description: Picogrid collaborated with the U.S. Army's 1st Cavalry Division at the National Training Center to integrate a multi-vendor counter-drone sensor network using its Legion integration layer, supporting Army modernization and training objectives.

press_references.value: Picogrid and Deepnight Bring AI-Enabled Digital Night Vision to Protect Critical Military Sites

partnership_announcements.description: Picogrid announced a new strategic partnership with Deepnight to integrate Deepnight’s AI-powered software-defined night vision into Picogrid-connected edge sensors and Legion software for military base and critical infrastructure defense, backed by a $1.7M Department of War contract to demonstrate the joint capability.

press_references.value: Picogrid Collaborating with Northrop Grumman for Military Software Modernization

partnership_announcements.description: Picogrid announced a collaboration with Northrop Grumman to integrate its Legion software into Northrop Grumman's AiON counter-drone C2 system to support U.S. air defense modernization.

press_references.value: Picogrid Adds Echodyne to Its Partner Ecosystem

partnership_announcements.description: Picogrid announced a new partnership with Echodyne, integrating Echodyne's advanced radar systems into Picogrid's Legion data platform, enabling enhanced threat detection and situational awareness for military and commercial customers.

overview_description.description: Picogrid is a technology company that develops hardware and software systems for integrating mission-critical assets across defense, public safety, and industrial environments. Its platform connects sensors, unmanned systems, command-and-control tools, and other digital infrastructure to support coordinated operations across land, sea, air, and space. The company provides products such as data integration platforms, edge computing nodes, and interoperability tools that enable information sharing and operational control across systems from different vendors. Picogrid supports use cases including base security, air defense, satellite operations, signals intelligence, wildfire monitoring, and human-machine teaming. Its technology is designed to help organizations manage and coordinate distributed systems through a unified operational framework.

press_references.value: Picogrid Wins $2.7M Next-Gen Command and Control Program

awards.description: Picogrid received a $2.7 million award from the U.S. Air Force to modernize command and control capabilities at Barry M. Goldwater Range East in Arizona. The project involves deploying an interoperable network of sensor nodes to monitor roadways, critical infrastructure, and natural resource areas, enhancing military readiness and operational efficiency.
